column1: # The benchmark Marketplace premium for a 40-year-old rose 12% in California in 2026, to $548 a month, against 22% nationally.

# Source: Urban Institute, American Affordability Tracker (ODC-BY 1.0): unsubsidized second-lowest-cost Silver premium for a 40-year-old, averaged by population. Most Covered California members pay much less after subsidies. KFF, which averages by enrollment, puts California's 2026 benchmark slightly higher.
